request: What are the costs of federal student loan forgiveness programs such as Public Service Loan Forgiveness?

reply.reply:
Federal estimates show sizeable costs for specific forgiveness actions, but there is no reliable all-program total in the reports checked. For PSLF waivers, ED estimated a $9.1 billion Direct Loan program modification cost (CRS R48152, PDF p. 16). ED estimated $14.1 billion for the separate IDR account adjustment (CRS R48152, PDF p. 15). The newer CRS overview explains that service-based forgiveness benefits are funded through mandatory budget authority and counted as federal student-loan subsidy costs (CRS IF13120, PDF p. 1). These are estimates for named actions, not a complete tally of actual spending; comprehensive public forgiveness data are unavailable, and individual modification estimates may change and should not be added into a grand total (CRS IF13120, PDF p. 1; CRS R48152, PDF p. 27).

See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-165804-117a.html) for details and evidence.
reply.reasoning: The reports provide a specific PSLF-waiver estimate and a comparison estimate for IDR, plus current CRS context on accounting and limitations. They do not support a comprehensive aggregate cost figure.
